title: A Prayer with All Her Heart
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Dear Hannah longed to hold a child,
And oh, how she would cry.
She went into the temple, where
She prayed to God on high.

[Chorus]
Pray with your whole heart, little one,
The Lord hears every word.
He answers in the best of ways,
Your prayer is always heard.

[Verse 2]
"Please give a son," she whispered, "Lord,
And he will serve You too."
God heard her prayer, and Samuel came,
And Hannah's dream came true.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So whisper what your heart needs most,
Then sleep, and do not fear.
Heavenly Father heard you, love,
And He is always near.

[Chorus]
mood: Prayer music. A slow, breathing pulse rises and falls under the voice, like someone kneeling quietly and pouring out her whole heart. The first verses carry a tender ache that lifts into joy when the answer comes, the sway staying hushed and reverent. By the last verse the pulse eases lower and slower, until the song is barely more than a whispered prayer over a sleeping child.
